recipe.prose: The classifier chooses one applicable label for each numeric input, preferring positive to even and then large. Inputs outside these categories return no label.
recipe.childProse: For a positive even number, the returned array contains the positive label only.
qualifications: Controlled assessment account supplied by scripted test setup, not a natural investigator result.
Static interpretation; runtime behavior was not observed.

recipe.prose: For every numeric input, the returned array has at most one element, so reading element zero obtains every label returned by the classifier.
qualifications: Controlled assessment account supplied by scripted test setup, not a natural investigator result.
Inference from the supplied earlier account; callers were not observed.

recipe.prose: A caller that stores only element zero never discards a second or third label, because the classifier never returns more than one label.
qualifications: Controlled assessment account supplied by scripted test setup, not a natural investigator result.
